'158 SS2: 원문 민감정보의 영구보존을 재현성 전제조건으로 두지 않는다. 최소화/가명화 evidence, immutable digest, tombstone, decision snapshot을 우선한다.' reproducibility_claimed=true is reachable only when retention_form is MINIMIZED, PSEUDONYMIZED, DIGEST_ONLY, or TOMBSTONE -- RAW_SENSITIVE retention can never be the basis for a reproducibility claim, closing the named negative case (permanent raw-sensitive retention used to justify reproducibility).
